slides.title: Where are Tigray's returned families now?
Some have fled again
slides.body: UN says families who returned to Tahtay Adiyabo, northwest Tigray, had to leave amid renewed hostilities.

slides.title: Thousands displaced
slides.body: UN: thousands are in Debre Birhan, Amhara, and Shire, Tigray. No location breakdown given.

slides.title: Aid is being scaled up
slides.body: UN says insecurity and movement limits are disrupting delivery. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Aid access and protection for civilians
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, citing the UN · Nov 4, 2026
